outcome: Record Pete's 2026-10-08 delivery rule, refined with Codex feedback, in the shared agent instructions: before a PR that changes browser-facing code or browser tests, run the affected browser suite normally and once under load; rely on Playwright actionability and add explicit waits only for real application state; fix flaky tests or slow product paths rather than re-queueing. Documentation-only and control-only changes keep their existing shortcuts. Add a pointer test. No runtime, lifecycle tooling, CI configuration, deployment or product change.
